reason: We have to replace lost volume and my two or three salespeople only look after existing accounts, so I need meetings from somewhere other than referrals. Nothing up front, 3 free meetings and a EUR 1,800 cap is a small bet next to what one new freight account is worth. I would take the free 15-company list, and if it looks right I would start the pilot in relationship mode, with every message approved by me.
objection: Our name in a small industry. If a Sofia agency sends sloppy or pushy messages to shippers in a new country, or we get a GDPR complaint, that costs me more than EUR 1,800. I also want to see that 45-meetings case with a name and a reference I can call, and how many of those meetings turned into quotes.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 15-company list or the sample first message looks generic or wrong for our niche, I walk away. A reference call with that logistics client could make me pay for more meetings sooner.
